title: Marked

At its center are two shirtless men, locked in an embrace, dancing — a quiet yet radical act. Overlaid with hand-inked 16mm film, their bodies become both seen and obscured, highlighted and erased. Through this layered process, Marked reflects on how queer love is shaped, celebrated, and scarred by the society that surrounds it.

title: Fork in the Road
overview: Fork in the Road is an intimate documentary that explores the profound connections between people, the land, and the future of our food system. Through a tapestry of compelling stories from independent small-scale farmers across the United States, from Alaskan kelp harvesters to dairy farmers in Kentucky, the film reveals the authentic, lived realities and unprecedented challenges of those working against the tide of escalating industrialization in agriculture. Featuring insights from visionary chefs and culinary experts, Fork in the Road expands the conversation beyond the farm, demonstrating how food sustainability is a shared responsibility that extends into our kitchens and communities. More than a call to environmental action, the film illuminates the vital ways that sustainable food practices can nourish our bodies, strengthen our communities, and heal the Earth.

title: Flowers of the Earth
overview: "Water lives in our bodies," a Kaiowá poet once said. "It evaporates into the air, becomes a cloud of love, falls as rain, sprouts the buds, blooms the flowers. We are Nature." For the Guarani-Kaiowá of Mato Grosso do Sul, there is no line where the body ends and the land begins. The earth is their skin, the tree their umbilicus, the mountains the bones of a living mother. But for over a century, that mother has been fenced, burned, mined, and poisoned, her children pushed onto slivers of the territory that once held them all. The film listens to the elders who remember the forest before the farmers came, before the native were clear-cut and the living land was carved into square plots of a single endless crop.

original_title: The World Is Our Dance Floor
overview: Exactly one year after a tragedy, a young writer carries on through the night as though it were any other. What first appears ordinary gradually reveals itself as something far more fragile.

title: Spirits Talk
overview: A grieving woman’s reality and memories begin to blur as her adoptive mother, Mother Nikki, reaches out to her from the spirit realm. She must speak to her mother one last time—or risk losing the ability to love herself and others.

title: The Lounge
overview: Unfairly overlooked employee Liz wants to become a successful corporate creature.

title: Dinamita
overview: After a harsh breakup, a soul-crushing job, and the pain of watching her ex move on with someone new, Cristina reaches a breaking point. What starts as a fleeting intrusive thought turns into a wild, reckless plan to erase him from her life — a choice that will send her down a path with no way back.

title: Peak Form
overview: After the sudden loss of a family member, Dan becomes fixated on improving his health, but online “experts” peddling wellness and life advice lead him down a dark and dangerous path.

title: Noise
overview: A first-time raver enters an underground club searching for escape, but the night descends into terror.

title: Captive
overview: In an attempt to break free of her company's meaningless tabloid stories, journalist Nicki Quinn documents a married couple's monumental extraterrestrial science experiment, unaware of the dangers that await.

title: Miss You, Love You
overview: Forced to plan her late husband's funeral with her estranged gay son's assistant, a blunt, grieving widow forms an unlikely bond with the total stranger as confronting their shared grief surfaces deep family secrets and long-held resentments.

title: What on Earth
overview: A fearful alien is sent to Earth to retrieve a fugitive from his own kind, but things get complicated as he has befriended a little girl who teaches them about love and human emotions.

title: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World
original_title: National Theatre Live: The Playboy of the Western World
overview: Pegeen Flaherty’s life is turned upside down when a young man walks into her pub claiming that he’s killed his father. Instead of being shunned, the killer becomes a local hero and begins to win hearts, that is until a second man unexpectedly arrives on the scene...

title: What's the Story, Wishbone?
overview: A behind-the-scenes journey into the creation and lasting legacy of Wishbone, the Emmy-winning PBS series that introduced a generation to classic literature through the adventures of a small dog with a big imagination.

title: A Life in Colour
overview: Lucy, an aspiring artist escapes into dreamlike visions through mysterious vials. As fantasy consumes her, she must choose which world to live in.

title: Where the Black Dog Runs
overview: As a rural village prepares for its final harvest festival as a luxury building development is greenlit, an ancient threat awakens and Julian must come face to face with a haunting piece of folklore.

title: Forever
overview: Ashton and Julie are about to go down two very different roads. As they take one last ride through their hometown, they reflect on the past, present, future, and forever

title: Achilles Returns
overview: After many years, with help of Thetis and negotiations between Zeus and Hades, the Greek hero Achilles is released from the Underworld into the modern world.

title: Bare Roots
overview: AMY reluctantly returns home to the windy clifftop in North Cornwall where she grew up, after a break-up with her partner Jess has left her homeless. She hopes her mum, SUE, will be pleasantly surprised at the chance for them to reconnect. But Sue isn't good with surprises, and has other things on her mind. She is preparing to plant a bare root hedge, her final act of resistance against the second home development that will surround her home, concreting over her memories and erasing her past. They start early: digging in the hedge is backbreaking work. When Amy finally manages to tell Sue about her loss, Sue is lost for words. They doggedly continue planting, gradually finding a rhythm together in the silence. As night falls, and exhaustion sets in, Sue returns to the house, and Amy is left in the field, digging the last trench for the remaining plants. Alone, they each find a way to reach out across the silence, the years of separation, and their losses, towards each other.

title: Ink Between the Lines
overview: After the devastating suicide of her best friend Coli, 15 year old Natalie turns to journaling to cope with her overwhelming grief. Struggling with guilt and isolation, she pours her emotions onto the page and joins a support group for teens. A deep conversation with Ezra, a friend who understands silent pain, inspires her to transform her journal entries into a novel. As Natalie writes, she begins to confront hidden truths about her friendship with Coli, unspoken struggles, and the weight of what was left unsaid. Through storytelling, she finds healing, connection, and the courage to speak the truth—not just for herself, but for others who need to hear it.

title: True Justice: Eye For An Eye
original_title: True Justice: Eye For An Eye
overview: Amateur sleuths tackle a fresh challenge at a local school, diving into the fierce world of parent politics. Their investigation uncovers hidden agendas and unexpected alliances as they navigate the complex web within the community.

title: She Won't Bite
overview: When she is bitten by a vampire, Gabriella resolves to put a stop to his wrongdoings.

title: I Remember Every Death
overview: Trapped in a brutal time loop where he remembers every death, a man must uncover the identity and rules of a sadistic architect who turned his life into a game, before the loop erases what’s left of his sanity.

title: Harry Hill: New Bits & Greatest Hits
original_title: Harry Hill: New Bits & Greatest Hits
overview: Harry Hill celebrated 60 years of fun, laughter and low-level disruption with a critically acclaimed tour.

title: eye see you
overview: During a classroom writing activity, a new classmate, Gela, tells hard-of-hearing Odesa, “I see you,” but she mishears it as “ICU”, sending her on a quiet journey to decode its true meaning.

title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
overview: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

title: GALICIA NON ARDE
overview: “GALICIA NON ARDE” is a short film that expresses the pain behind each provoked fire in Galicia during the summer of 2025.  A young man goes to his town in Lugo after learning from the media that it is on fire, evoking a strong feeling inside him.  Through photography, color, and sound, it seeks to create a sensory space where viewers can immerse themselves in a complete experience.

title: Sight Unseen
overview: Three siblings inherit their estranged father's rural cabin after his mysterious death. They slowly realize someone, or something, still lives there.

title: Silent Voices
overview: In New York, a Korean immigrant family of four leads separate lives, each facing moments of defeat in their daily existence. As they navigate complexities of survival and disconnection, they each hide their wounds from one another

title: One More Day
overview: Ed is blessed with the gift of time travel, able to reset the day at will. He uses this gift to correct his mistakes, giving him what he thinks is the perfect mistake free life. However, after a painstaking attempt to create the perfect date, he discovers that this is the day his grandad dies. Unable to come to terms with his grandad's passing. Ed uses his powers to reset the day over and over continuously torturing himself transforming his gift of time travel into a never-ending curse.

title: INTERCHANGE
overview: At Westfield Marion, there is an interchange. At Westfield Tea Tree Plaza, there is an interchange. Between these shopping centres, a number of events occur, and several spectres appear.

title: Holding Water
overview: Over the course of an afternoon in late spring, two longtime friends reunite under a mulberry tree to confront the ways their time apart has changed them.

title: These Hands Aren’t Mine
overview: As their own hands become strange and distant, a filmmaker reconstructs their identity through MRI scans and 35mm film.

title: A GOOD DAY TO VOMIT HARD
original_title: A GOOD DAY TO VOMIT HARD
overview: The anticipated follow up in the iconic improvised anthology series.

title: [MV]
overview: I was supposed to make another music video but I couldn't. I couldn't do it anymore. I needed to make a weapon. A device I could finally torture myself inside of, for real, forever.

title: A Chef's Tale: The Real Story of Duet
original_title: A Chef's Tale: The Real Story of Duet
overview: A documentary crew follows two New York City chefs and the life of their restaurant, but when tragedy strikes, the crew must go down a genre-bending search for the truth.

title: Dire Duplicity
overview: A tormented secret agent with emotional and psychological problems attempts to stop an international cyber attack. This dark emotional mystery intensifies as he is betrayed by those he trusts and loves.

title: FEED
overview: While doomscrolling on social media, Dylan receives some strange, otherwordly messages.
